mda_summary: Management is focused on Blinkit profitability inflection by FY26, with adjusted EBITDA breakeven targeted by Q4FY25. Food Delivery has reached steady-state contribution margins; growth is now coming from order frequency rather than user acquisition. Hyperpure continues to scale but at thinner margins; the path to profitability there is FY27+. Capital allocation priority: 1) Blinkit dark stores, 2) Hyperpure cold-chain, 3) selective bolt-on M&A. No equity raise contemplated for FY25.
